_about.purpose: Phase 11 evaluation query set. SILVER (provisional) labels — authored by the project, not yet expert-validated. Numbers computed against it must be reported as preliminary until Dr. Sunita T. Pandey / the expert gold-set replaces or ratifies these labels.
_about.labelling: Two levels. BOOK level (available now): `relevant_books` marks which treatise(s) plausibly address the condition — supports Precision@k, nDCG, MRR, Hit@k. PASSAGE level (added later): `relevant_chunk_ids`, once populated, additionally makes Recall@k well-defined, since only then is the true number of relevant passages known.
_about.query_style: Queries are SYMPTOM-led, not crop-led, because the classical texts are general and symptom-based rather than crop-indexed. The crop is recorded separately as context only.
_about.coverage_relabel_2026_09_15: expect_answerable was originally true for all 22 non-negative queries — an ASSUMPTION, never verified against the corpus. Coverage check (§6m, scripts/check_coverage.py) scored every query with the pipeline's own cross-encoder: 4 strong (>=0.35), 5 marginal (0.15-0.35), 13 no match (<0.15). The 13 are now expect_answerable=false with the score recorded. Over-refusal must be reported on the answerable subset; the original file is preserved as silver_queries.pre_coverage.json. This is a finding, not a patch: it quantifies the gap between classical IKS aetiology and modern lesion-based disease labels.
